name: Lyo.FileTags.Images
tagline: EXIF read and write for picture tags.
description: Picture tags for [`Lyo.FileTags`](../Lyo.FileTags/README.md). Extensions are jpeg, png, webp, gif, and tiff. Read maps EXIF artist, date, description, and copyright onto `FileTagKey`. Any other EXIF name is `Custom`. Write sets those mapped tags and saves the image. Width, height, and format stay on [`IImageService.GetMetadataAsync`](../../Images/Lyo.Images/README.md).
features: **Write.** Sets artist, image description, copyright, and original date. `ClearExisting` replaces the EXIF profile first.
**Not pixels.** This provider does not resize, transcode, or report width and height.

examples.title: Read the artist on a JPEG

sections.title: Public types
rows: IFileTagReader and IFileTagWriter for picture extensions.
